# Native development

Learning Planner can run as a native process while the shared infrastructure
provides PostgreSQL and NATS. Start and inspect that infrastructure from
`learning-platform-infrastructure` before running the service.

```sh
task run:native
```

The adapter reads `../../learning-platform-infrastructure/.env` by default;
set `LW_INFRA_ENV_FILE` only when the approved private environment file is
elsewhere. It does not print the file contents, credentials, or configured
URLs. Use `task native-config-test` to test the adapter against synthetic
values without reading the private infrastructure environment.

The infrastructure-owned `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_*` values describe the
registered topology. The adapter fails closed if a required mapping is missing
or does not use loopback. Keep these values aligned with
`learning-platform-infrastructure/assets/native-port-registry.json`:

| Variable | Native value |
| --- | --- |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_HTTP_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_HTTP_PORT` | `18093` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_POSTGRES_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_POSTGRES_PORT` | `5432` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_DATABASE` | `lw_planner` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_NATS_URL` | `nats://127.0.0.1:4222` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_STUDENT_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:18084` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_COURSE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:18083` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_AI_PROMPT_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:18092` |
| `LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_TZ_PLANNER_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:18088` |

The adapter derives `DATABASE_URL` in the child process from the existing
`LW_PLANNER_DB_USER` and `LW_PLANNER_DB_PASSWORD` values. If the dedicated
password is absent, it uses the approved shared `LW_POSTGRES_PASSWORD` value.
It maps existing infrastructure-owned service tokens into the service's
runtime environment and never copies secrets into native topology variables.
TZ Planner is configured as a loopback endpoint because the service config
requires its URL and token; its HTTP API is used only by optional project
authoring create/get/resume operations.

The current SQL migrations have no durable migration ledger and the existing
`migrate-up` task applies raw SQL directly. This repository therefore adds no
native migration or status task. Do not run `task migrate-up` against the
shared `lw_planner` database as part of native startup; migration planning
requires a separate reviewed strategy.

## Docker path

The regular Docker Compose and `task run` paths keep their existing environment
configuration. The native adapter supplies endpoint overrides only to its
child process; it does not change domain or use-case configuration.
